title: 0.3.1 immutable baseline
content: The legacy/v0.3.1 ref points to 67280cd84feb89faec6a80f5fe2a55ce5f7b89e6. This is the user-verified working baseline and must remain unchanged. The 0.3.2.dev4 preview stays opt-in; do not use main as a silent rollback source.

title: Real ADS-B provenance and source overlays
content: Display RF-only as R, Internet-only as I, and same valid ICAO in both as I/R without duplicates. Original tar1090 must open without antenna using genuine Internet observations; native Linux RF is readsb, not desktop WebUSB. Do not synthesize aircraft.

title: Dual GitHub Pages parity
content: The canonical browser source is this repository. Two Pages origins must use the identical built source: standalone flight radar and TEXT-CENTER mirror. Exact source-revision SHA and actual site responses need independent checking; source CI alone is insufficient.

title: Protected broker security tests
content: Draft PR #55 reports 176/176 scoped CI checks on source SHA 2e7ef7246787fcb210fa19ab6436d1da0ce0ff28, including separate-UID broker cases. Independent review, production consent, power-loss and native privileged-helper acceptance remain HOLD.

title: Shared receiver and shutdown safety
content: External readsb/tar1090 processes and files are borrowed services; Quit/Hard Stop should only release resources owned by Flight Radar. Background OFF/on-demand and exclusive SDR coordination prevent interrupting other apps.

title: Next safe Codex mission
content: Review current exact PR and CI, preserve old drafts and legacy branch, plan isolated QA for real-data provenance, native platform parity, protected broker and dual Pages. Do not merge, install or publish.
